<!-- Adding or updating a listing? Tick these off. -->

- [ ] One folder: `mods/<YourName>@<mod id>/` with `meta.json`, `description.md` (and optionally `thumbnail.png`, PNG, at most 1024×1024 and 2 MB)
- [ ] `id` matches the `id` in the mod's own `mod.toml`
- [ ] The mod's repository has a GitHub Release with `<id>-<version>.zip` attached (or `downloadURL` points at an installable `.zip`)
- [ ] The mod contains no game data: no files copied from the discs, the BIOS or other copyrighted material
- [ ] The validate check is green
